title: FireKing 72" Fire-Rated Storage Cabinet
body_html:
Fire-rated protection for the documents you can’t afford to lose.

This FireKing cabinet carries a U.L. Class 350 one-hour fire rating, shielding oversized documents, binders, end-tab filing, and banker’s boxes from heat and water damage. A high-security Medeco keylock and water-resistant build keep contents secure long after the sprinklers stop.

Key features

  • UL Class 350 one-hour fire rating — interior stays below 350°F
  • Water-resistant against sprinklers and fire hoses
  • One fixed plus four adjustable shelves, up to 160 lbs each
  • Pull-out work tray and upright blueprint holder
  • High-security Medeco keylock

Who it’s for

Records departments, municipal and hospital archives, and any institution that must protect oversized documents and media from fire.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
